typical_symptoms: No necrotic lesions, spots, streaks, or stripes present
Complete absence of chlorosis, mosaic patterns, or yellowing
No visible fungal growth, pustules, or signs of pest damage
Normal vibrant green coloration across the entire leaf surface and midrib
visual_characteristics: Vibrant, uniform green leaf blade with a distinct, clean white central midrib
Smooth and intact leaf margins without tearing, necrosis, or burning
Clean leaf surface free of powdery residue, soot, rust pustules, or lesions
Proper turgor pressure indicated by flat, upright, and firm leaf structure
lesion_characteristics: Completely free of necrotic centers, spots, or chlorotic halos
color_characteristics: Rich, healthy green color representing normal chlorophyll content
Bright white midrib running continuously down the center of the leaf
Absence of yellowing, reddish-brown stripes, or mosaic discoloration
texture_characteristics: Smooth and firm leaf blade texture
No water-soaked areas, wrinkles, dry patches, or powdery spore masses
spatial_patterns: Uniform and even distribution of color across the entire leaf canopy
No clustered spots, linear streaks, or irregular necrotic patches
distinguishing_features: Complete absence of disease symptoms, blemishes, and discoloration
Uniform green blade contrasted cleanly by the prominent white midrib
commonly_confused_with: Initial symptoms of ring spot or brown stripe
